item.title: Iran launches heavy barrage at Jordan
item.description:
Dozens of missiles were launched towards US bases in Jordan following a US attack on Iranian oil tankers, reports said.
The barrage was clearly visible from Israel, but did not cross into Israeli territory.

item.title: This is the Religious Zionist Party’s Knesset slate
item.description: The Religious Zionism Party has submitted its Knesset slate, with Ohad Tal pushed down to 12th place. “We acted responsibly to unite the national camp."

item.title: Jordan: 20 ballistic missiles launched from Iran, 18 intercepted
item.description:
Jordan announced that 20 ballistic missiles were launched from Iran toward its territory, with its air defense systems intercepting and destroying 18 of them.
According to the statement, the two remaining missiles landed in areas away from population centers. No casualties were reported in the attack.

item.title: Chikli: We are inches away from the Yamam receiving orders from the Shura Council
item.description:
Minister of Diaspora Affairs Amichai Chikli attacked the Ra'am party and its candidate Yoav Segalovitz on Tuesday evening.
“We are inches away from the Yamam receiving orders from the Shura Council. This is not a hand on the wheel; it is a hand on the trigger of the State of Israel," Minister Chikli said.

item.title: IRGC confirms strikes on US military base in Jordan
item.description:
Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) confirmed that it launched missiles at a US military base in Jordan in response to US attacks on Iranian oil tankers.
At the same time, the IRGC announced plans to attack oil tankers in Kuwait and Bahrain and called on their crews to “abandon the ships."

item.title: Rubio warns Iran: Every time they attack US ships, they will lose tankers
